item.title: 'Shingeki no Kyojin' Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
item.description: Voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida, best known for Grisha Yeager in Shingeki no Kyojin (Attack on Titan) and Daikichi Kawachi in Usagi Drop (Bunny Drop), died on October 11 of heart failure. He was 54. His agency, 81 Produce, announced the news on Tuesday, noting that the funeral was held privately for family members only, at the family’s request. Born in Tokyo…

item.title: Visual Novel Creator Jun Maeda Diagnosed with Pharyngeal Cancer
item.description: Jun Maeda, the acclaimed writer and composer known for visual novels such as Kanon, Air, Clannad, and Little Busters!, has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer. Visual Arts/Key announced the news on Monday, revealing that Maeda has opted to forgo active treatment in favor of palliative care so he can conserve his strength and continue his creative work.…
